title: Decision record: remember/memories scoping + init semantics under topology (a)
description: Two semantic decisions, since both flow through prefix today. (1) remember/memories (cmd/bn/cmd_memory.go) are prefix-scoped today (rs.prefix at cmd_memory.go:29 and filter at :100; --global / --all escape hatches exist), so under topology (a) they become per-repo automatically — DECIDE and record whether memories should be per-repo or global, and how --global/--all map. (2) init (newInitCmd, app.go:46): decide whether it still takes --prefix or whether non-interactive auto-register subsumes it. Record both decisions; they block the cmd_memory.go and init adoption beads.
design:
DECISION: Memory Scoping

Keep current behavior: memories are scoped to rs.prefix (= repo slug under topology-a) by default. This is correct — memories about a codebase should be repo-local. Two flags:
  * remember --global: stores with NULL prefix (global memory, visible from any repo context)
  * memories --all: searches all prefixes (cross-repo view)

Under topology-a this requires NO change to cmd_memory.go — prefix==slug already makes memories per-repo automatically.

DECISION: Flag vocabulary

Keep --global on 'remember' (semantic: where to STORE the memory, not a listing scope). Keep --all on 'memories' as the canonical flag for backward compat. Add --all-repos as an alias for --all on memories for consistency with the rest of the multi-repo CLI (list/ready/dep all use --all-repos). beans-ac9 implements the --all-repos alias.

DECISION: Init semantics

bn init --prefix=<proj> remains the explicit project initialization step. Auto-register (via git remote URL in tryGitAutoDetect) is for runtime issue routing only — not a replacement for init. bn init writes the .bn marker which sets up workspace context for skills. No change to init semantics. beans-xlp does not need to change init; it should ensure .bn marker interaction is documented.
close_reason: Design decisions recorded: memory stays per-repo, flag vocabulary frozen, init semantics documented
